release_notes:
- FFT Queue now finds and attaches PDFs for articles that are also in another library of the same project. Before, it reported "0 found" even though the PDF had been downloaded.
- FFT Advanced no longer takes the PDF away from the copy of the same article in another library: both copies now keep their own PDF.
- Windows: if you install a different version of R, Nexus SR now installs its packages for that version instead of stopping with "there is no package called 'shiny'" every time it starts.
